name: Aferiy Solar Panels - 200W

verified_facts: The 200W Aferiy Solar Panel, foldable, IP65 weatherproof, 23% efficient monocrystalline solar charging for any solar generator. Built with advanced monocrystalline silicon cells rated at 23% conversion efficiency, a multi-layered ETFE lamination, and an IP65 waterproof rating. The lightweight, one-piece foldable design includes a built-in adjustable kickstand, and USB-A, USB-C, and MC4 connectors let it charge devices directly or connect to virtually any solar generator.
